# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

[ Learn more ][229]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.

# Revolutionise care for people and planet

## Transforming care for patients and caregivers

At Mölnlycke, we have always been dedicated to improving quality of life for patients and those who
care for them. We do it by offering innovative, high-quality solutions for wound care and surgical
procedures, and by helping you implement new, better ways of working. Ultimately, we enable safer,
more efficient and more sustainable care. For people and planet.

# Revolutionise care for people and planet

Watch full video

## Transforming care for patients and caregivers

At Mölnlycke, we have always been dedicated to improving quality of life for patients and those who
care for them. We do it by offering innovative, high-quality solutions for wound care and surgical
procedures, and by helping you implement new, better ways of working. Ultimately, we enable safer,
more efficient and more sustainable care. For people and planet.

 
* [
  
  ## Wound care solutions
  
  Explore our offer of innovative solutions that are optimised for health care workflows while
  improving quality of care for patients.
  
  Discover our wound care solutions
  ][34]
* [
  
  ## Surgical solutions
  
  A safe and stress-free care environment, where clinicians can perform at their very best, doing
  the job they care most about.
  
  Discover our surgical solutions
  ][35]

Get in touch

## We're here to help

If you have any question about our products and solutions or need assistans, contact our sales team.
We look forward to helping you find the perfect solution for your needs.

[Contact us][36]

## Latest updates

Discover our latest offers and campaigns.

## Let's make room for what matters

There are many examples of non-value added tasks, in or around the OR, that could easily be
eliminated, simply by implementing more efficient ways of working.

[Read more][37]
* [
  
  ## Find the right antiseptic product
  
  Our antiseptic products are gentle on the skin and effective on microbes with long lasting effect.
  Support skin integrity and reduce the potential of infections.
  
  Read more
  ][38]
* [
  
  ## Introducing the new Mepilex Up:
  
  An innovative foam dressing designed for exuding wounds.
  
  Read more
  ][39]

> ‘I always double-glove, and have from the very beginning. It's never been a challenge to work this
> way.’
>

  ### Changes to Mölnlycke Health Care Board of Directors
  
  **Gothenburg, Sweden. 23 June 2026. **Mölnlycke Health Care (Mölnlycke®), a global leader in
  MedTech, today announces changes to its Board of Directors. Christian Cederholm will leave his
  Board assignment, while Filippa Stenberg will take his place as member of the Board. Thomas Kidane
  will step in as deputy board member.
  
  ][45]
* [
  8 June, 2026
  
  ### Mölnlycke Health Care strengthens global manufacturing footprint to power future growth in
  ### wound care
  
  **Gothenburg, Sweden. 8 June 2026.** Mölnlycke Health Care (“Mölnlycke^{®}”), a global leader in
  MedTech, today confirmed a combined investment of approximately EUR 40 million in Mikkeli,
  Finland, and Oldham, UK. The investments strengthen the company’s global wound care manufacturing
  network by increasing capacity, optimising process quality and enhancing supply chain resilience
  and sustainability. 
  
  ][46]
* [
  21 May, 2026
  
  ### Mölnlycke Health Care and Zhende Medical form pioneering joint venture to expand access to
  ### advanced wound care solutions in China
  
  **Gothenburg, Sweden, and Shanghai, China. 21 May 2026.**
  Mölnlycke Health Care (“Mölnlycke®”), a global leader in MedTech and advanced wound care
  solutions, and Zhende Medical, a leading supplier of medical care and protection in China, today
  announce the formation of a new joint venture company in China to accelerate growth in one of the
  world’s fastest-growing wound care markets. The joint venture, majority-owned by Mölnlycke, will
  integrate the two companies’ wound care portfolios and commercial capabilities to offer healthcare
  providers, patients and the public expanded access to advanced treatments, improved care delivery
  and better patient outcomes across China.
  
  ][47]

  Infection* shows that introducing a simple glove change during caesarean birth could deliver
  millions in cost savings for the National Health Service (NHS) in England.  
  
  ][48]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

# Advanced Mobile Wound Care, Delivered Where You Are

Healix360 coordinates access to physician-led advanced wound care for patients in their homes,
assisted living communities, and skilled nursing facilities across Southern California and Nevada.
Licensed physicians and nurse practitioners deliver hospital-grade treatment for chronic and complex
wounds — including diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ulcers, pressure injuries, post-surgical wounds,
and arterial ulcers.
* Medicare Part B accepted
* In-home physician visits
* Care typically begins within 3–5 business days
* Serving Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, Ventura, San Diego counties and Las Vegas

[Call 877-545-1300][2] or [request a provider][3] to begin care. Healix360 serves Southern
California and Nevada and accepts Medicare Part B and most major insurance plans.

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ## **Overview**

INTEGRATED® is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) based in Houston, Texas USA. From it’s
beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and engineer
industry standard pressure and flow control equipment that is utilized in the drilling and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas industry worldwide.

INTEGRATED® “State of the Art” manufacturing plants (Capital Equipment and Elastomers) are fully API
licensed facilities that operate as per our certified API / DNV Quality Management Systems (QMS)
processes. These facilities manufacture our OEM and Aftermarket products.

INTEGRATED® products are utilized worldwide by Land &  Platform Drilling Contractors, Well Service
Companies (including Snubbing), Rental Tool Companies, Completion Companies, major and independent
Energy Companies and are distributed globally through either INTEGRATED facility, Authorized
Licensed Repair Facilities (ARLF) or territorial partnerships.

## **Overview**

INTEGRATED® is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) based in Houston, Texas USA. From it’s
beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and engineer
industry standard pressure and flow control equipment that is utilized in the drilling and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas industry worldwide.

INTEGRATED® “State of the Art” manufacturing plants (Capital Equipment and Elastomers) are fully API
licensed facilities that operate as per our certified API / DNV Quality Management Systems (QMS)
processes. These facilities manufacture our OEM and Aftermarket products.

INTEGRATED® products are utilized worldwide by Land &  Platform Drilling Contractors, Well Service
Companies (including Snubbing), Rental Tool Companies, Completion Companies, major and independent
Energy Companies and are distributed globally through either INTEGRATED facility, Authorized
Licensed Repair Facilities (ARLF) or territorial partnerships.

## A focus on

## The Full Wound Care Continuum, Under One Roof

## Wound care rarely comes down to a single product or a single step. It's a continuum — from
## assessment, to debridement, to advanced treatment, to closure. New Horizon brings together five
## modalities so clinicians can address every stage of that continuum, backed by the billing,
## education, and clinical support to make it all work in practice.
1. Diagnostic Imaging
   
   Our exclusive U.S. partnership with Kent Imaging brings SnapshotNIR and SnapshotGLO to the point
   of care — providing non-contact visualization of tissue oxygenation and areas of elevated
   bacterial load to inform clinical decision-making.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][126]
2. (UAW) Debridement
   
   Our Söring UAW instruments use 25 kHz ultrasonic cavitation to remove devitalized tissue and
   disrupt biofilm while preserving surrounding tissue — enabling precise debridement in the OR,
   clinic, or bedside, often under local anesthesia.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][127]
3. NPWT
   
   Platform Wound Dressing (PWD) replaces foam and gauze with a transparent, single-layer design
   that distributes negative pressure evenly across the wound surface — operating at pressures as
   low as −50 mmHg.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][128]

   Our exclusive U.S. partnership with Kent Imaging brings SnapshotNIR and SnapshotGLO to the point

   [ LEARN MORE ][126]
2. (UAW) Debridement
   
   Our Söring UAW instruments use 25 kHz ultrasonic cavitation to remove devitalized tissue and
   disrupt biofilm while preserving surrounding tissue — enabling precise debridement in the OR,
   clinic, or bedside, often under local anesthesia.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][127]
3. NPWT
   
   Platform Wound Dressing (PWD) replaces foam and gauze with a transparent, single-layer design
   that distributes negative pressure evenly across the wound surface — operating at pressures as
   low as −50 mmHg.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][128]
4. Advanced Skin Substitutes
   
   Our biologics portfolio — including AdvoGraft One, XAM, and AmchoPlast — features amniotic and
   placental-derived allografts intended for use across a range of acute and chronic wounds, aligned
   with today’s regulatory and reimbursement requirements.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][129]
5. Micro-Autografting
   
   The Xpansion® Kit transforms a small donor sample into evenly sized micro-grafts, designed to
   maximize wound coverage while minimizing donor site size — with procedures that can be performed
   under local anesthesia, in or out of the OR.
   
   [ LEARN MORE ][130]

tissue oxygenation, ultrasonic debridement to address biofilm, a skin substitute to support
coverage, and negative pressure therapy to manage the wound environment. When each of those
modalities comes from a different vendor, clinicians lose time and practices carry more operational
burden.

New Horizon consolidates the continuum. One partner, one portfolio, one point of contact — spanning
assessment, debridement, treatment, and closure.

Beyond products, our team delivers reimbursement expertise, clinical education, and hands-on
implementation support — so the full continuum integrates into your practice.

### Series5 Lateral Tilt Mattress
* A specialist lateral tilt mattress offering very high clinical benefits, especially for
  palliative, end of life care and complex needs. Providing effective and proven pressure
  redistribution, tissue immersion and envelopment, combined with shear reduction and microclimate
  management, make this a brilliant mattress for acute, hospice and community care.
  
  No minimum user weight – suitable for very low weight patients/residents.
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][104]
* [OSKA Series5 Mattress Specialist pressure care mattress with pump, blue with foam and air cell
  cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series2 Mattress
* A high specification foam mattress, offering a reactive pressure relief support surface for
  patients at an elevated risk of pressure ulceration. It is also effective for managing patients
  with Category 1 and 2 pressure ulcers. The unique OSKA heel Offloader feature also supports the
  management of patients with any category of heel pressure ulcer.
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][105]
* [OSKA Series2 Mattress Pressure Care Mattress Blue with foam cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series4H Hybrid Mattress
* Innovative, high-specification hybrid mattress. As a reactive support surface, it offers effective
  pressure ulcer prevention for patients at an elevated risk of pressure ulceration.
  
  Effective for managing Category 1 & 2 pressure ulcers (pumpless).
  
  Effective for managing Category 3 & 4 pressure ulcers (pumped).
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][106]
* [OSKA Series4H Hybrid Pressure Care Mattress blue with foam and hybrid cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series6 OneSurface™
* A unique, clinically proven support surface that can assist organisational quality improvement and
  harm reduction programmes by reducing pressure ulcer (PU) incidence.
  
  Combining innovative design with engineering excellence, the Series6 OneSurface™ delivers optimal
  pressure ulcer prevention for the highest risk, most dependent patients in any care setting with
  any category of pressure ulcer.
  
  No minimum user weight – suitable for very low weight patients/residents.
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][107]
* [OSKA Series6 OneSurface Mattress pressure care mattress, blue, with foam and air cell cutaway]

## Advanced Pressure Ulcer Prevention Solutions for Healthcare Providers

As trusted specialists in clinical pressure care, we deliver evidence-based pressure ulcer
prevention solutions, approved and recommended by Tissue Viability Nurses and Occupational
Therapists. Our clinically backed products support healthcare professionals in the prevention,
management and treatment of pressure ulcers across NHS hospitals, hospices, care homes, and
community care settings.

#### Care Home Operators

Enabling care providers to deliver an Advanced Pressure Care Strategy, while saving time and money.
Our innovative pressure relieving mattresses help improve clinical outcomes in care homes, boost
resident comfort, and streamline care delivery.

[CARE HOME SOLUTIONS][108]

#### NHS Acute & Community

Partnering with NHS Trusts nationwide, we provide advanced pressure relieving mattresses and other
support surfaces designed to enhance patient care in both acute and community settings. Our
innovative solutions are designed to improve clinical outcomes, support staff efficiency, and meet
the evolving needs of modern healthcare.

[NHS SOLUTIONS][109]

#### Hospices & Palliative Care

Enhancing comfort and dignity in end-of-life care, our clinically proven pressure care products are
designed specifically for hospices and palliative environments. Ideal for patients with progressive
or life-limiting illnesses, our solutions help improve quality of life in the last days of care.

[HOSPICE SOLUTIONS][110]

#### Community Equipment Services

Designed to reduce community-acquired pressure ulcers, our pressure care products offer superior
comfort to support patient compliance, enable single-handed care, and help lower maintenance and
servicing costs commonly associated with air mattresses. Ideal for community equipment services
seeking cost-effective, clinically effective solutions.

### Series5 Lateral Tilt Mattress
* A specialist lateral tilt mattress offering very high clinical benefits, especially for
  palliative, end of life care and complex needs. Providing effective and proven pressure
  redistribution, tissue immersion and envelopment, combined with shear reduction and microclimate
  management, make this a brilliant mattress for acute, hospice and community care.
  
  No minimum user weight – suitable for very low weight patients/residents.
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][104]
* [OSKA Series5 Mattress Specialist pressure care mattress with pump, blue with foam and air cell
  cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series2 Mattress
* A high specification foam mattress, offering a reactive pressure relief support surface for
  patients at an elevated risk of pressure ulceration. It is also effective for managing patients
  with Category 1 and 2 pressure ulcers. The unique OSKA heel Offloader feature also supports the
  management of patients with any category of heel pressure ulcer.
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][105]
* [OSKA Series2 Mattress Pressure Care Mattress Blue with foam cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series4H Hybrid Mattress
* Innovative, high-specification hybrid mattress. As a reactive support surface, it offers effective
  pressure ulcer prevention for patients at an elevated risk of pressure ulceration.
  
  Effective for managing Category 1 & 2 pressure ulcers (pumpless).
  
  Effective for managing Category 3 & 4 pressure ulcers (pumped).
  
  [VIEW PRODUCT][106]
* [OSKA Series4H Hybrid Pressure Care Mattress blue with foam and hybrid cutaway]

Prev Next

### Series6 OneSurface™
* A unique, clinically proven support surface that can assist organisational quality improvement and
  harm reduction programmes by reducing pressure ulcer (PU) incidence.
  
  Combining innovative design with engineering excellence, the Series6 OneSurface™ delivers optimal
  pressure ulcer prevention for the highest risk, most dependent patients in any care setting with
  any category of pressure ulcer.
  
  No minimum user weight – suitable for very low weight patients/residents.

## Advanced Pressure Ulcer Prevention Solutions for Healthcare Providers

As trusted specialists in clinical pressure care, we deliver evidence-based pressure ulcer
prevention solutions, approved and recommended by Tissue Viability Nurses and Occupational
Therapists. Our clinically backed products support healthcare professionals in the prevention,
management and treatment of pressure ulcers across NHS hospitals, hospices, care homes, and
community care settings.

#### Care Home Operators

Enabling care providers to deliver an Advanced Pressure Care Strategy, while saving time and money.
Our innovative pressure relieving mattresses help improve clinical outcomes in care homes, boost
resident comfort, and streamline care delivery.

[CARE HOME SOLUTIONS][108]

#### NHS Acute & Community

Partnering with NHS Trusts nationwide, we provide advanced pressure relieving mattresses and other
support surfaces designed to enhance patient care in both acute and community settings. Our
innovative solutions are designed to improve clinical outcomes, support staff efficiency, and meet
the evolving needs of modern healthcare.

[NHS SOLUTIONS][109]

#### Hospices & Palliative Care

Enhancing comfort and dignity in end-of-life care, our clinically proven pressure care products are
designed specifically for hospices and palliative environments. Ideal for patients with progressive
or life-limiting illnesses, our solutions help improve quality of life in the last days of care.

[HOSPICE SOLUTIONS][110]

#### Community Equipment Services

Designed to reduce community-acquired pressure ulcers, our pressure care products offer superior
comfort to support patient compliance, enable single-handed care, and help lower maintenance and
servicing costs commonly associated with air mattresses. Ideal for community equipment services
seeking cost-effective, clinically effective solutions.

[COMMUNITY SOLUTIONS][111]

## More Than A Distributor

We believe there is always a solution to any problem, and we’re looking to solve even the most
challenging ones.

[SEE THE DIFFERENCE][157]

[[Mission-Critical Performance, Trusted Worldwide.]][158]

## Mission-Critical Performance, Trusted Worldwide.

Aerospace, defense, medical, industrial—connectors that perform when it matters most.

[SEE INDUSTRY SOLUTIONS][159]

## Connectors

High-performance connectors for harsh environments — from MIL-Spec, D-Sub, circular, and RF to
custom configurations.

[VIEW PRODUCTS][160]
[cable-assembly]

### Cable Management

Keep your systems protected, organized, and performing with a wide range of cable management
solutions — from heat shrink and conduit to glands, grips, and labels.

[BROWSE PRODUCTS][161]

### Contacts

Mil-Spec, crimp, and shielded contacts for secure, high-performance connections in aerospace,
telecom, and extreme environments.

[LEARN MORE][162]
[trafag-pressure-sensor-featured]

### Cable Assemblies

Simplify your application with custom-engineered cable assemblies from the experts. Our design
services deliver robust solutions for harsh environments and critical systems.

[DISCOVER SOLUTIONS][163]
[pma-flexible-sb]

### Sensors & Controls

Pressure, temperature, and position sensors that integrate seamlessly with your cable and connector
systems.

[SHOP NOW][164]

### Backshells

Military and commercial backshells for circular and rectangular connectors — for added support,
protection, strain relief, and EMI shielding.

[FIND SOLUTION][165]
[aph_environmental_m85049_product]

### Tools

Crimp, assembly, and cable tools from trusted brands — designed to ensure high-quality connections
and meet industry standards every time.

[SHOP NOW][166]
[aph-m85049-product]

### All Products

PEI-Genesis is franchised for Amphenol, ITT Cannon, Cinch Connectivity Solutions, LEMO, Conesys,
Anderson Power, Souriau, and Sunbank by Eaton, Positronic, and more.

[SHOP NOW][167][VIEW LINE CARD][168]

## Our Vision — More Than A Distributor

PEI-Genesis is more than a distributor — we’re a community of engineers dedicated to solving your
most complex interconnect challenges. We act as your partner, advisor, and trusted resource,
connecting with you on a deeper level than ordinary distributors ever could. We believe every
problem has a solution — and we’re driven to find it.

[LEARN MORE][169]

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## We Provide Expert, Compassionate Wound Care Services

## effective healing and long-term recovery.

[Royal Wound Care who we are]

## **Who we are**

## At ***Royal Wound Care***, we specialize in treating chronic, non-healing wounds using today’s
## most advanced techniques—because every patient deserves expert care and a faster path to
## recovery.


Led by Dr. Moaddel, a ***board-certified wound*** specialist, our dedicated team delivers
compassionate, personalized treatment—whether at our West Hills clinic or directly within nursing
facilities throughout the San Fernando Valley.

## **What sets us apart**

## At* ****Royal Wound Care***, personalized care is more than a commitment—it’s our standard. As a
## locally operated, patient-focused clinic, we believe healing is best guided by both **expertise
## and compassion**.

## Our care is led by **board-certified wound care physicians**, reflecting advanced medical
## training and a focused dedication to wound healing as a specialty. This level of clinical
## expertise allows us to provide thoughtful, individualized treatment while maintaining the close,
## one-on-one attention larger organizations often can’t.

## You’re not just a case, you’re part of our community, and we’re here to support you through every
## step of your healing journey.

[Royal Wound Care what sets us apart]
[Specialized Wound Care at the Bedside]

# **Specialized Wound Care at the Bedside**

## We deliver expert wound care at the bedside to speed healing, reduce costly hospital
## readmissions, and help keep patients recovering comfortably at home.

[Advanced Clinical Modalities]

# **Advanced Clinical Modalities**

## We offer cutting-edge treatments including debridement, NPWT, skin substitutes, and infection
## control protocols—right where care is needed.

[Compliance Standards]

# **Compliance Standards**

## We follow CMS guidelines and proven practices to boost compliance, support surveys, and reduce
## regulatory risk—while working closely with your team.

[Provider Training & Clinical Support]

# Provider Training & Clinical Support

## We empower your team with on-site training and wound care certification—improving compliance,
## boosting outcomes, and strengthening in-house care.

## Every 30 seconds

## Someone loses a limb because of a wound that won’t heal.

[Royal Wound Care]

## If you’re dealing with something similar, you’re not alone—**there’s real help available.**

## Backed by ***board-certified professionals*** and leading-edge treatment, ***Royal Wound Care***
## gives patients the best chance at faster, more complete healing.

[WHY IS ADVANCED WOUND CARE IMPORTANT?][32]

## **Why Partner with Royal Wound Care?**

## Elevate Your SNF’s Standard of Care. Reduce Readmissions. Stay Survey-Ready.

## When it comes to skilled nursing facilities, wound care is the frontline of risk. Poor management
## leads to rehospitalizations, survey violations, frustrated families—and worst of all, preventable
## suffering. At ***Royal Wound Care***, we partner with **SNFs** to provide expert-level bedside
## wound and skincare services that protect your patients and your reputation.

[LEARN MORE][33]

## Advancing the future of wound care through ***research***, ***innovation***, and
## ***board-certified* *expertise***.

At **Royal Wound Care**, our provider is the ONLY Board-Certified Wound Care Specialist in the
region. And now, we’re empowering other professionals to level up too. The **Wound Care Nurse
Certification (WCN-C**) course is a nationally recognized training designed for licensed nurses and
clinical teams seeking CEUs, re-certification, and real-world skills. Through expert-led instruction

Market Byte 7.21.2026
Renesas’s open-market demand trends are uneven,** with the strongest growth seen in clocking and
timing components and PMICs**.
Market Byte 7.16.2026
Shortages of DDR4 modules—still being used in the current retail and consumer markets—continue to
outpace those of all other types of modules. However, **DDR5 RDIMMs will soon outstrip all other
modules as the main target of spot shortages**.
Market Byte 7.14.2026
Ceramic capacitors, especially MLCCs, are **Murata’s most in-demand passive components**, driven
mostly by AI data centers along with steady automotive and industrial use.
